description: This Scala source file defines a helper class 'PythonStreamingQueryListener' for handling Spark StreamingQueryListener events in Spark Connect, managing communication with a Python process for streaming query events.

classes.name: PythonStreamingQueryListener
classes.description: A helper class for handling StreamingQueryListener events in Spark Connect, facilitating communication with a Python process for streaming query event handling.

methods.name: onQueryStarted
methods.description: Handles the event when a streaming query starts, serializing the event to JSON and passing it to the Python process.

methods.name: onQueryProgress
methods.description: Handles streaming query progress events, serializing to JSON and passing to Python process.

methods.name: onQueryIdle
methods.description: Handles the event when a streaming query becomes idle, serializing to JSON and passing to Python process.

methods.name: onQueryTerminated
methods.description: Handles the event when a streaming query terminates, serializing to JSON and passing to Python process.

methods.name: stopListenerProcess
methods.description: Stops the Python streaming listener process.

methods.name: handlePythonWorkerError
methods.description: Handles errors reported by the Python worker during event processing, raising exceptions as needed.
